original_question: Write the Verilog code for a module named `sky130_fd_sc_hd__fahcon`. This module should implement the logic of a full adder. It takes three single-bit inputs: `A`, `B`, and `CI` (carry-in). It produces two single-bit outputs: `SUM` (the sum bit) and `COUT_N`. The `COUT_N` output should represent the *inverted* value of the standard carry-out bit. Implement the module using gate-level primitives.
